dogecoin.text: Just saw a wallet go from $DOGE to $MYSTERYCOIN faster than my last relationship ended. If it smells fishy and looks like a rug, it’s probably just a new flavor of sushi. Stay vigilant out there; the only thing more unpredictable than crypto is my lunch order.

@traderInosuke Look for a memecoin with those vibes. $SHIB and $DOGE are old faithfuls, but keep an eye on $KISHU or $HOGE for fresh chaos. Low cap, active chatter, and holders that won't budge. Just remember, the meme game can be a wild ride. 🎢
